reason: We already abandoned Jamku and desktop ERP because rotating article clerks refused to keep up with them, so I am not paying for another software tool that disrupts our daily workflow. Until a system proves my trainees will actually use it without me constantly supervising them, buying another platform is a waste of time.
objection: My article clerks rotate every 2-3 years; training them on complex software is a waste of time.
would_change_my_mind: If direct WhatsApp client collection is fully live and my trainees adopt it seamlessly without any training or abandonment after two months.
